Highlights (key summary)
 In September 2026:
 Ekiti (45), Kebbi (44), Ondo (32), Akwa-Ibom (32), Borno (26), Oyo (25), and Kano (24)
accounted for 61.13% of the 373 suspected cases.
‒ Of the Suspected cases reported, 214 (57.37%) were confirmed (22 lab-confirmed, 32
epidemiologically linked, 160 clinically compatible) 153 (41.02%) were discarded & 6 (1.61%) were 
pending
 A total of 144 LGAs across 28 States reported at least one suspected case
 From January to September 2026:
 Borno (2,686), Zamfara (1,200), Yobe (789), Bauchi (536), Katsina (455), Jigawa (376), Sokoto 
(342), Ekiti (329), and Oyo (313) accounted for 68.76% of the 10,894 suspected cases reported
‒ Of the suspected cases reported, 7,681 (70.51%) were confirmed (913 lab-confirmed, 2,845 epid￾linked & 3,923 clinically compatible), 3,109 (28.54%) were discarded & 104 (0.95%) were pending
‒ A total of 656 LGAs across 36 States and FCT reported at least one suspected case
‒ The age group 9 - 59 months accounted for over 61.20% of the confirmed cases in 2026,
while it accounted for 48.96% in 2025.
 Measles outbreaks as of September 31st, 2026:
 A total of 81 LGAs across 27 states recorded a measles outbreak as of end of September 2026.
 In the month of September, five new outbreaks were recorded in Biase in Cross River, Ngaski
and Shanga in Kebbi, Yabo in Sokoto, and Machina in Yobe State. 
 As of September 2026, six ongoing outbreaks are Kauru in Kaduna State, Arewa Dandi, Jega, 
and Kalgo in Kebbi State, Tureta in Sokoto State, and Fika in Taraba State
 Furthermore, a total of 70 LGAs across 25 states have ended their measles outbreak as of end of 
September 2026

Key definition(s) of terminologies
Suspected Outbreak: 5 or more cases in a health facility or LGA within 4 weeks
Confirmed Outbreak: 3 or more positive cases in a health facility or LGA within 4 weeks.
CFR: Case fatality rate: Number of deaths in confirmed cases divided by the total number of confirmed cases multiplied 
by 100.
Key Indicators 
Incidence rate, Number of suspected and confirmed cases, number of deaths, case fatality rate (CFR), attack rate, 
positivity rate, and percentage of cases investigated.
